intent: Allow selected-model progress explanations to recur after a newly captured immutable source identity, while retaining same-source repeat suppression and source-owned authority boundaries.
authorization: The user authorized the shared PR implementation and publication work. The coordinating review reserved this narrow preview correction before edits; this local candidate does not publish, merge, dispatch a provider or change an execution permission.
finding: The existing authored-summary key retains rendered fact strings and resource-state epochs but drops source commit and result identity. After explanations A then B, a read of the same path/range at another commit can leave A suppressed even though its captured source changed.
constraints: Consume existing bounded execution-receipt fields; do not parse or hash raw source bodies in the progress path.
Bind repository, connection-qualified tool, exact path/range, commit and captured result digest.
Saved, retained, cursor, failed, mismatched, absent or explicitly unverified identities cannot refresh current preview identity.
The preview epoch cannot verify source coverage, authorize execution, alter completion or manufacture chart counts.
Preserve all existing ordinary regression method bodies and the 45-second/135-second cadence.
Do not run a local Kotlin, Android, provider or privacy/application harness. Ordinary project CI must execute the additive behavioral controls.
The integrator owns generated metadata, exact release scope, current-source canonical validation and guarded public append.

validation.old_tests: All nine prior methods and the complete prior test file reconstruct exactly after removing the additive block and two imports.

independent_review.scope: Fourteen exact source/producer/caller/test inputs; production and test inverses preserve all prior behavior and nine methods. Seven additive ordinary methods still require hosted runtime.

validation.publication_binding: The guarded GitHub append must have identical local/public trees and retain the actual current public parent; server-created commit identifiers are recorded in the external publication receipt.
validation.incoming9473: Preserved the complete Responses retained-work source, tests, notes and metadata while composing the two independently reviewed GitHub corrections; no source/test component bytes changed.
validation.incomingDcfe: Preserved the complete unheaded PR-context recovery and retained-backend-work changes while composing the exact independently reviewed preview source/test bytes.

implementation.identity_channel: Locally generated execution-receipt semantic summary, with the same captured result digest and original call ID retained by GitHubResultViews.
implementation.effect: Only the existing authored-preview evidence epoch changes on a newly admitted or changed captured identity; factual observations and model-authored ownership remain unchanged.
conservative_limitations: A path at or above the producer truncation boundary of 256 characters cannot establish an exact identity here.
A compact or legacy receipt missing the range, digest, hash scope, call binding or repository identity keeps the prior preview behavior.
A present negative or malformed verification field refuses the identity; no network-live field is required when a complete immutable local capture has no such field.
Ordinary project CI must execute the new behavioral methods. No source-only or host-formatting result qualifies Android, a provider run or deployment.
